title: Introducing: the Metriport Network Directory Browser
summary: Metriport launches it's new Network Directory Browser, giving Metriport customers the ability to search through Metriport's national network of 100,000+ providers to see who is connected for comprehensive clinical data exchange.
body_markdown:
For Day 4 of our Launch Week, we're proud to introduce our latest feature: the Metriport **Network Directory Browser** ! 📜


This new tool enables our customers to easily search through Metriport's national network of 100,000+ providers, to see who is connected for comprehensive clinical data exchange.


Teams no longer need to wait to see what hospitals, clinics, specialists, and provider orgs are in-network and interoperable—they can now answer these questions themselves on the Metriport[Dashboard](https://www.metriport.com/dashboard) , within seconds.


‍


‍
Read how to access this via API in our developer docs:[https://docs.metriport.com/medical-api/api-reference/network/list-network-entries](https://docs.metriport.com/medical-api/api-reference/network/list-network-entries)


Interested in becoming a Metriport customer?[Get in touch](https://www.metriport.com/contact-us) with us today, or book a[demo with us here](https://calendly.com/colinelsinga/metriport-intro) .
